notes: Cats: Portugal in both banks (58 Régionale, 29 Village), which hold every Portuguese still wine stem; the Port and Madeira style stems under Sparkling/Fortified/Sweet and Fortified Wines belong to the fortified-wines subject and are left out. Chapters: the Régionale portugal chapter and the Village Portugal chapter (facts 1 to 5 and 7, traps 1, 2 and 5); the fortified chapters carry Port and Madeira for that subject. Regions: one article per DOP the Court names, Vinho Verde, Douro (which holds Porto as well), Dão, Bairrada, Alentejo and Madeira; Lisboa, Tejo and Setúbal are left out because the Court does not name them. Country: portugal for the DOC and Vinho Regional ladder and the renaming of grapes. Grapes: the Court's grapes the Codex profiles, Touriga Nacional and Alvarinho (under Albariño); the Madeira whites and Tinta Negra have no grape record. Techniques: steep-slopes (the roster's must-link for douro, the Court's terraces), port-fortification and madeira-estufagem-canteiro for the two fortified DOPs of the Introductory winemaking and style cells. No service table: the Court's Portugal page has no service or pairing cell.
